title: It is well with my Soul
lyrics_original: When peace, like a river, attendeth my way,
When sorrows like sea billows roll;
whatever my lot, thou hast taught me to say,
It is well, it is well with my soul
It is well (church: It is well)
with my soul (church: with my soul)
it is well, it is well with my soul.
Though Satan should buffet, though trials should come,
that Christ has regarded my helpless estate,
and hath shed his own blood for my soul.    || It is well ||
My sin, oh, the bliss of this glorious thought!
My sin, not in part but the whole,
is nailed to the cross, and I bear it no more,
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, O my soul     || It is well ||
And, Lord, haste the day when my faith shall be sight,
The clouds be rolled back as a scroll;
The trump shall resound, and the Lord shall descend,
even so, it is well with my soul.      || It is well ||

bible_verses.telugu: అప్పుడు సమస్త జ్ఞానమునకు మించిన  దేవుని సమాధానము యేసుక్రీస్తువలన మీ హృదయములకును మీ తలంపులకును కావలి యుండును.
bible_verses.english: And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా ఈలాగు సెలవిచ్చుచున్నాడు ఆలకించుడి, నదివలె సమాధానమును ఆమెయొద్దకు  పారజేయుదును మీరు జనముల ఐశ్వర్యము అనుభవించునట్లు ఒడ్డుమీద పొర్లిపారు జలప్రవాహమువలె మీయొద్దకు దానిని రాజేతును మీరు చంకను ఎత్తికొనబడెదరు మోకాళ్లమీద ఆడింపబడెదరు.
bible_verses.english: For this is what the Lord says: “I will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flooding stream; you will nurse and be carried on her arm and dandled on her knees.”

bible_verses.telugu: నీవు ఆమెను ఎదు ర్కొనుటకై పరుగున పోయినీవును నీ పెనిమిటియు నీ బిడ్డయు సుఖముగా ఉన్నారా అని అడుగుమని తన పనివాడైన గేహజీతో చెప్పి పంపెను. అందుకామెసుఖముగా ఉన్నామని చెప్పెను.
bible_verses.english: Run to meet her and ask her, ‘Are you all right? Is your husband all right? Is your child all right?’ ‘Everything is all right,’ she said.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for holding my life in Your hands through every season of peace and trial. When the storms of life feel overwhelming, remind me of Your unchanging grace and redeeming love. Grant me the deep peace that surpasses all understanding, so that my heart may rest securely in You. Teach me to trust You completely and declare with confidence that it is well with my soul. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for holding my life in Your hands through every season of peace and trial. When the storms of life feel overwhelming, remind me of Your unchanging grace and redeeming love. Grant me the deep peace that surpasses all understanding, so that my heart may rest securely in You. Teach me to trust You completely and declare with confidence that it is well with my soul. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Life brings seasons of gentle peace as well as overwhelming storms, yet our ultimate security never depends on our changing circumstances. When we fix our eyes on Jesus, we remember that He has already looked upon our helpless state and anchored us in His redeeming love. As you sing this hymn, let your heart rest in the blessed assurance that Christ holds your life securely. Even amid sorrow or trial, you can place your trust in Him and declare with quiet confidence that all is well with your soul.
